Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the superintendent of public instruction from encouraging or promoting the teaching of sexual orientation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting the superintendent of publicinstruction from encouraging or promoting the teaching of sexualorientation; adding a new section to chapter 28A.300 RCW; and creatinga new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that there is alegitimate and compelling state interest in ensuring that the sincerelyheld values and beliefs of most parents regarding sexual orientationare not denigrated or denied by our public schools and the teaching ofsexual orientation should not be presented or promoted to our youth. The legislature further finds that the office of superintendent ofpublic instruction has published materials that encourage thepresentation of sexual orientation to the early grades and that thisteaching is inappropriate and unacceptable.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.300RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The office of superintendent of public instruction shall notencourage or promote the teaching of sexual orientation.
